progress.language_caveat: The 1,874 count is canonical meta.language=en. Only the 16 authored rows plus 12 pilot-screened English candidates were manually read as English; five pilot candidates were visibly non-English despite the metadata, and the remaining rows still need content-language screening.

job_schema_note: Each jobs.jsonl row is one original root. Source Q/A is referenced by canonical line and SHA, not duplicated. Existing pilot rows list all three variants as drafts pending human review.

cursor_contract.ordering: job_order is zero-based and sorted by source_index ascending.
cursor_contract.cursor_rule: Recompute next_cursor as the lowest job_order whose state is not DRAFT_AUTHORED_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW. Skip those authored drafts; do not advance on partial variants.
cursor_contract.increment_boundary: Record status after each complete source (all three variants). For resumable batches, target at most 16 source jobs per batch; the operator may stop earlier at a complete-source boundary. No time-per-source estimate is recorded.
cursor_contract.scope_triage_rule: The 17 pilot-screened rows are not globally deleted from the 1,874-source population; resolve their screening notes in the pilot manifest before authoring them for the full job.

pilot_screening_reference.note: These are pilot exclusions/triage flags, not silently removed from the full 1,874-job population.

row_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of the canonical JSONL raw line after stripping only its trailing LF or CRLF; same definition as the pilot manifest.

job_file_revision_history.reason: The initial generated per-row hashes included the line ending despite the declared source-row hash definition. All 1,874 job row hashes were regenerated to exclude LF/CRLF consistently with the pilot manifest.
